decisions.reason: High prior investment, central scope, and public commitment lead management to persist and keep the product despite unproven results.
Sunk costs and public commitment to this established-offer extension make management escalate commitment and keep it.
Because the firm has invested and publicly committed to this portal, disappointing market signals are attributed to temporary causes, so it is kept.
The app builds on the established offer with sunk costs and public commitment, so management keeps it consistent with escalation of commitment.
